newsitem.title: USA: H.B. Fuller, EMS-Chemie in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: H.B. Fuller, EMS-Chemie in joint venture.

text.p: H.B. Fuller Co said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to combine its automotive adhesives, sealants and coatings businesses with those of EMS-Chemie Holding AG.

The new venture will be called EFTEC and will have operations in North America, Europe and the Far East, the companies said. The businesses being combined have total annual revenues of more than $250 million, H.B. Fuller said.
H.B. Fuller makes sealants, coatings, adhesives and other specialty chemical products.
Its shares closed up 1/4 Thursday at 50-1/2.
